'''Falcons''' were a species of flying birds of prey. They were known for swooping down on their prey from a perch.

"Falcon" was a word that was commonly used in the names of independent [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that operated throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SS">{{GamerCite|1|Shipbuilding Secrets}}</ref>
